## Summary

Provide a brief but clear overview of the change and the problem it addresses.

- What changed?
- Why is this needed?
- Does this affect the theme, documentation, examples, generated assets, or build workflow?

## Issue reference

**Please reference the relevant issue or discussion in the PR description.**

## Checklist

- [ ] I have linked the related issue or discussion to this PR.
- [ ] I have described the change and the purpose clearly.
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation, examples, or release notes when needed.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for the changed behavior.
- [ ] I have followed the repository coding style and conventions.
- [ ] I have reviewed my changes before submitting this PR.
- [ ] If I introduced a new theme option or configuration setting, I have documented it and updated the relevant examples and/or theme documentation table where appropriate.
- [ ] The PR title follows conventional commit style (for example: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `test:`).
